name: Ness Electronics, Inc.
old_description: The ALL NEW Televes Multi-Market 8 Bay is here. It's a great antenna if you need a Bi-directional antenna. We partnered with Televes to design this antenna and it is exclusively available at Ness Electronics.
about:
Ness Electronics, Inc. operates from Burnsville, Minnesota, and has recently relocated to a facility in Mendota Heights as part of Industry Tech Sales. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business functions as a distributor and authorized dealer for television antenna and signal reception products. Its catalog includes the Televes Multi-Market 8 Bay antenna—developed through an exclusive partnership with Televes—Sky Blue antennas backed by a five-year warranty, Winegard antennas, BullFrog corrosion protection compounds, and Screen Kleen cleaning solutions. Ness Electronics serves both retail customers through its online store and professional installers and retailers via a wholesale program.

Primary customers include professional antenna installers, audio-video dealers, and residential consumers seeking over-the-air reception equipment. The company also supplies BullFrog products used in industrial and military corrosion protection applications.

Ness Electronics differentiates itself through exclusive product arrangements, such as the Televes Multi-Market 8 Bay available only through its channels, and by offering extended warranty coverage on its Sky Blue line. Its authorized dealer status for Winegard and focus on installer-friendly wholesale pricing further define its market position.
